item.title: UN experts condemn Russia's convictions of ICC prosecutor and judges
item.description: A Moscow court has convicted ICC prosecutor and eight judges in absentia, a move UN human rights experts have denounced as blatant breach of international law.

item.title: Trump reignites calls to revamp US electoral system and 'nationalise' voting
item.description: US President has called for Republican party to "nationalise" voting, suggesting the federal government should take over elections in 15 locations.

item.title: Gaza receives 54 Palestinian bodies and boxes of remains after Israeli custody
item.description: Gaza's health ministry has confirmed the transfer of 54 Palestinian bodies and 66 boxes of remains released by Israel via the Red Cross.

item.title: Gulf states, US wrap up 11-day regional security exercise in Qatar
item.description: The 11-day exercise was hosted by Qatar amid heightened tensions between US and Iran.

item.title: Fuel train derails, erupts in flames in central Russia
item.description: A blast near the Tambov station ignites 16 tank cars, forcing emergency crews into a major containment operation.

item.title: Australia dodges call to arrest visiting Israeli president
item.description: Australia faces mounting pressure over an invitation to Israeli President Isaac Herzog, as a UN-linked human rights lawyer urges his arrest and pro-Palestinian groups plan protests ahead of the visit.

item.title: Venezuela's interim president urges dialogue with US
item.description: 'If there is one thing in which Venezuelans are united, it is that any controversy, any disagreement with the United States government must be addressed diplomatically,' says Delcy Rodriguez.

item.title: Russia vows to keep oil flowing to Cuba amid rising US pressure
item.description: Moscow's envoy pledges continued energy support to Havana as Washington escalates sanctions and threats over Cuban oil imports.

item.title: Daily News Brief | 5 February
item.description: Presidents Erdogan, Sisi push Türkiye–Egypt cooperation as Gaza crisis and regional conflicts dominate talks, and Pakistan PM says Islamabad will boycott its cricket match against India at the T20 World Cup.

item.title: Maori protesters interrupt New Zealand PM's speech at national day gathering
item.description: Christopher Luxon faced chants of 'treason' from a Maori crowd while addressing Waitangi Day celebrations amid ongoing tensions over Indigenous rights.
